description: This file implements the core logic for 'git config' commands, including listing, getting, setting, unsetting, renaming sections, removing sections, editing, and other configuration management functionalities. It defines usage messages, command handlers, option parsing, and internal helper functions for managing Git configuration files.

methods.name: option_parse_type
methods.description: Parses and sets the type of a configuration value based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: location_options_init
methods.description: Initializes configuration location options based on command-line flags and environment.

methods.name: location_options_release
methods.description: Releases resources allocated for location options.

methods.name: display_options_init
methods.description: Initializes display options for configuration output.

methods.name: cmd_config_list
methods.description: Handles 'git config list' command to display all configuration entries.

methods.name: cmd_config_get
methods.description: Handles 'git config get' command to retrieve specific configuration values.

methods.name: cmd_config_set
methods.description: Handles 'git config set' command to set configuration values.

methods.name: cmd_config_unset
methods.description: Handles 'git config unset' command to remove configuration entries.

methods.name: show_editor
methods.description: Prepares and launches an editor for editing the configuration file.

methods.name: cmd_config_edit
methods.description: Handles 'git config edit' command to edit configuration.

methods.name: cmd_config_actions
methods.description: Main handler for various 'git config' subcommands based on parsed options.

methods.name: cmd_config
methods.description: Main entry point for 'git config' command, dispatching to subcommands or actions.
